description.value:
You grew up respecting both your family and the natural world. You understand the culture of the Five Nations, yet you stay out of the games of ambition and status others play. You know the beauty and power of life, the mysteries of birth and death, and the miracles in between. Your understanding of nature lets you see through the lies and tricks of city folk—without ever revealing how much of their deception you notice.

Ability Scores: Constitution, Wisdom, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.Q7HygZaibbzumnEX]{Mark of Handling}

Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling and Nature

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulHerbalismK]{Herbalism Kit}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulHerbalismK]{Herbalism Kit}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagNet00000000]{Net}, 29 GP; or (B) 50 GP
